mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by quarter-over-quarter percent change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 QoQ growth accelerates, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals increasing economic activity and supply-side momentum that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises >0.5% MoM, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points in a month signals an improving labor market and increased consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops >0.2pp MoM, but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.5 million units per month, it signals overextended construction activity that will lead to a supply glut and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1.5 million units, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a speculative housing bubble that will soon burst and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth > 1% MoM and UNRATE < 5%, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 0.5% in a month, and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a manufacturing recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS > 3%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, especially if the initial UNRATE is above 6%.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.3pp MoM, but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time when initial UNRATE > 6%.
